scoring_justification: Recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible because the checker does not have the MD trajectory or nitrogen coordinates. The agent only produces a single JSON with two numbers, so consistency tier is not applicable. Scoring uses structural physical bounds and a comparison to the paper’s reference values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported DDAB bilayer thicknesses: top surface 23.5 Å, bottom surface 22.9 Å (Table 3, 39.1 wt% DDAB without K⁺).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the paper’s reported values for the DDAB system without surface potassium ions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published values from the original study that the reproduction must approximate.

outputs.description: DDAB bilayer thickness on top and bottom mica surfaces, and molecular orientation distribution histogram, computed from MD trajectory.

output_contract.notes: The bilayer thickness is scored against hidden reference values and plausibility checks. The orientation distribution (if present) is scored via structural audit checking the histogram shape.

steps.description: Score top_L and bottom_L against paper gold (23.5, 22.9) with ±1.5 Å tolerance, plus physical range (15-30 Å) and symmetry (|top_L−bottom_L| ≤ 2.5 Å).
